name: miodesk
description: Local workspace tools and session handoffs through a connected miodesk MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and work in your local workspace through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Use the connected miodesk server to inspect files, make scoped edits, run bounded commands, check connection status, and resume work across sessions. Requires a running miodesk service and connection; results are text and structured data.
defaultPrompt: Use miodesk to inspect or update this workspace.
